record.tooling: Apps for iOS/Android/Windows plus a browser page. No documented API; the LAN path is a local protocol, not a storage interface.
record.chaining: 100 GB x unlimited transfers, but every link self-destructs in 6/12/24 hours. The LAN mode is a file-transfer convenience, not storage.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap: 100 GB by link. Retention: 6, 12 or 24 hours, or after first download. That is the shortest retention of any 100 GB-class service found.
record.reliability_note: Open source and E2E encrypted, but retention is measured in hours. Useful as a staging/burner channel, never as storage.
